It appends a freshly constructed event then deep-copies a nonempty working template via C578B0. The candidate clones all private replacements first, then repeats the established canonical ownership clear/adopt sequence.

C578B0 deliberately leaves newly constructed payload58 and runtime88 unchanged. Replacement therefore requires explicit permission for original event payload rebuilding and defers compilation to the final native check.
Templates must come from actual existing events on a UserWindowObject, classTypeId0x12, and event IDs must be unique in the new list. Missing native event metadata is not fabricated.
Unknown native partial ownership result is never automatically freed, rolled back or retried. A normal private object is freed only on its explicitly owned successful pre-adoption path.
